company.shortDescription: Digits is a fintech company that offers financial tools for small businesses.
company.description: Digits is a fintech company building tools for businesses and finance professionals by leveraging its proprietary Living Model technology. The company was founded by Wayne Chang and Jeff Seibert in 2018 and is headquartered in San Francisco, California, United States.

productsAndServices.description: Cloud-based accounting software that combines an AI-native general ledger, automated bookkeeping, reconciliations, bill pay, invoicing, and real-time financial reporting for small businesses and accountants.
productsAndServices.name: Digits AI-Native Accounting Platform

productsAndServices.description: AI-powered bookkeeping that categorizes transactions continuously, learns from user input, reconciles bank and card activity, and organizes supporting receipts, contracts, and invoices.
productsAndServices.name: Real-Time Bookkeeping and Reconciliation

productsAndServices.description: Real-time financial dashboards and statements for monitoring cash, spending, runway, revenue, expenses, and overall financial health.
productsAndServices.name: Live Dashboards and Financials

productsAndServices.description: Accounts payable software for uploading bills, routing them for approval, and making payments while maintaining related records in the accounting ledger.
productsAndServices.name: AI Bill Pay

productsAndServices.description: Invoicing software for creating professional invoices, sending them to customers, tracking payments, and issuing payment reminders.
productsAndServices.name: AI Invoicing

productsAndServices.description: Automated month-end close workflows that collect bank statements, identify errors and anomalies, manage close checklists, and support review before financial data is finalized.
productsAndServices.name: Agentic Close
